item.title: Trump praises Nexstar-Tegna broadcast television deal he once opposed
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump endorsed Nexstar Media Group's $6.2 billion purchase of broadcast rival Tegna on Saturday, an apparent reversal from earlier criticism of the deal. “We need more competition against THE ENEMY, the Fake News National TV Networks,” Trump wrote on social media. “Letting Good Deals get done like Nexstar — Tegna [...]

item.title: Jury finds Guntersville man guilty of 2023 murder, corpse abuse of Athens woman
item.description: On Friday, a Marshall County jury found a Guntersville man guilty of murdering an Athens woman and abusing her corpse back in October 2023.

item.title: Athens man sentenced to three life sentences for drug, weapon convictions
item.description: The Limestone County Sheriff's Office says an Athens man was sentenced to three life terms for multiple drug trafficking and gun-related charges.

item.title: AHSAA denies top ranked Oakwood's appeal, season ends afterextra game played
item.description: The state's athletic association said that Oakwood Adventist Academy self-reported a scheduling error that led to the team playing 31 games. Under AHSAA rules, teams are only allowed to play 30 in the regular season.

item.title: Appeals court overturns Huntsville man's capital murder conviction in 2016 'crime spree'
item.description: The Alabama Court of Criminal Appeals overturned the capital murder conviction and death sentence of a Huntsville man on Friday.

item.title: Scottsboro City Schools exploring options after AHSAA denies classificiation appeal
item.description: Scottsboro City Schools Superintendent Jennifer Williams says the system is exploring options, including legal action, after the Alabama High School Athletic Association denied its attempt to appeal Scottsboro High School's new athletic classification.

item.title: Limestone County judge sentences man in child solicitation, attempted trafficking case
item.description: A man has been sentenced in Limestone County Court following convictions for electronic solicitation of a child, traveling to meet a child for unlawful sex acts, and attempted human trafficking.

item.title: Huntsville man killed in South Carolina plane crash
item.description: A Huntsville man was killed in a plane crash in South Carolina on Friday, officials said.

item.title: Huntsville music legend Microwave Dave dead at 80
item.description: The Microwave Dave Music Education Foundation announced his death Saturday morning.
